---
description: Java and Kotlin engineering rules.
applyTo: "**/*.java,**/*.kt,**/*.kts,**/pom.xml,**/build.gradle,**/build.gradle.kts"
---
# Java / Kotlin

- Detect Maven/Gradle, Java/Kotlin versions, framework, test stack, and code-generation steps.
- Respect package/module boundaries and dependency injection patterns already in use.
- Do not assume Spring, Android, JUnit, or a specific build convention until verified.
